openapi.mutability: Tailscale states that documented endpoints are stable but the generated OpenAPI is unstable. Generation verifies byte length, SHA-256, identity, server, inherited global auth, operations, parameters, media, and no-pagination text before writing artifacts.
evidence: 90 operations across 58 paths with no deprecated operation
exact server https://api.tailscale.com/api/v2 and one global inherited HTTP bearer security scheme
thirty-six body operations, including JSON root objects, arrays and strings plus three HuJSON-capable policy routes
sixty-two JSON-capable successes, two HuJSON-capable policy responses, and twenty-eight empty successes
the embedded first-party guide explicitly states that the API has no pagination and returns all results at once
openapi.title: Tailscale API

pagination.provider_contract: The Tailscale API does not currently support pagination. All results are returned at once.

supported_provider_inputs: OAuth client or federated-identity access token

authority_notes.details_accept_conflict_resolution: details=true is static and Accept is omitted only on policy_file.get_policy_file_details
authority_notes.separate_cli_family: tailscale CLI and tailscaled daemon are intentionally outside this HTTP pack family
authority_notes.response_unsafe_integers: Every application/json success uses unsafe_integers=string; HuJSON remains exact text.

source_decision.reason: Tailscale control-plane devices, network services, keys, users, invitations, logs, DNS, webhooks, and policy are not semantically honest task, note, or user-work project Sources.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Tailscale calls the endpoints stable but explicitly calls the generated OpenAPI unstable.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Byte- and SHA-256-lock the live first-party YAML, retain the exact extract, and fail generation on any identity, route, media, auth, or pagination drift.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The document server carries /api/v2 while origin-only runtime bases are required to avoid version-prefix URL replacement.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Use https://api.tailscale.com as the runtime base, emit /api/v2 on every path, and declare openapi_source.path_alias.wire_prefix=/api/v2.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The API accepts Basic username tokens and Bearer tokens, while trust credentials mint short-lived scoped Bearer tokens.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Standardize the pack on connection-owned Bearer authentication so credentials cannot enter operation arguments and both personal and OAuth access tokens use one safe wire contract.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Thirty-one of thirty-six body-bearing operations omit requestBody.required despite requiring configuration or action input to be useful.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Require one bounded non-whitespace body_raw value for every documented body operation and preserve JSON or HuJSON media exactly.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Policy reads have an Accept-versus-details incompatibility and policy writes, previews, and validation support materially distinct JSON and HuJSON media.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Expose five explicit details/HuJSON variants so no operation emits the forbidden details-plus-Accept combination and HuJSON comments remain lossless.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Key creation, invitation reads/creates, webhook creation/rotation, and OAuth app creation can return bearer-like one-time secrets.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Record exact secret field paths, require approval for every mutation, keep the capabilities directly callable, and exclude every secret response route from bundled workflows.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Setting a policy without If-Match can overwrite a concurrent administrator change.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Expose the documented optional header.If-Match argument with newline rejection and describe the ETag precondition workflow on both JSON and HuJSON set operations.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The device-list filter is documented as a pseudo-parameter whose actual query parameter name is caller-selected.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Do not pretend the pseudo-name is a real wire key or admit arbitrary query-name injection; retain the complete unfiltered list plus the ordinary closed fields selector.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Tailscale explicitly declares no pagination, including audit and flow log endpoints.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declare no automatic or manual paginator and describe all list workflows as one complete provider response rather than inventing cursors.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Device and key identifiers, counters, and expiry durations can be integer-shaped and may exceed JavaScript exactness over time.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Parse every JSON success with unsafe_integers=string and send all request bodies as literal text without conversion through Number.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Response objects often contain several arrays, so heuristic single-array extraction would turn resources into accidental collections.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Use an explicit authority-audited collection result_path map and leave direct arrays or multi-array resource objects intact.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Shared schemas include writeOnly posture and log-destination credential fields in response positions.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Drop writeOnly properties from compact response schemas, separately flag request-secret routes, and keep those routes out of workflows.

audit_findings_folded.finding: All ninety operations inherit one top-level bearer security declaration instead of repeating security per operation.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Assert that every operation continues to inherit exactly the global bearerAuth contract and reject operation-level security drift.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The API returns twenty-eight successful responses with no documented body and one JSON null response.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Omit response schemas and JSON parsing for truly empty successes while retaining an explicit null schema for the JSON-null operation.

audit_findings_folded.finding: The local tailscale CLI controls an installed client and daemon but is not the remote administration API.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Keep CLI commands, daemon prerequisites, and local auth state out of this HTTP family; reserve them for a separate tailscale CLI pack.

audit_findings_folded.finding: Tailnet devices, services, keys, users, and policy are network control-plane resources rather than user-work tasks, notes, or projects.
audit_findings_folded.resolution: Declare no work_entity_sources and state the semantic decision in every leaf, the root, and this audit fixture.
